engines: Tüm VAG Benzinli (TSI/TFSI) ve Dizel (TDI) Motorlar
commonCauses: Kablo Tesisatı ve Soketleri and/or Connectors faulty
stepByStepSolution: Kontrol edin: /Repair Kablo Tesisatı ve Soketleri and/or Connectors
Kontrol edin: /Değiştirin / Yenileyin:  Door Kontrol Modülü(s)
technicalNotes:
This fault code describes that the Convenience System Data Bus is operating in Single Wire mode.
You can Kontrol edin: the door Kontrol Modülüs by Tahliye / Kesme all of them and reconnecting them one after another, while checking the comfort system meas. blocks regarding the data bus status.
